# AstryxSegmentedControl { #anylumino.AstryxSegmentedControl }

```python
AstryxSegmentedControl(items, value, *, label, **props)
```

Render a compact Astryx segmented control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type            | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Default    |
|---------|-----------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| items   | Iterable\[Any\] | Item records used by generated child components or static search sources.                                                                                                                                                                                              | _required_ |
| value   | str             | Synchronized component value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | _required_ |
| label   | str             | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | _required_ |
| **props | Any             | JSON-safe SegmentedControl props. Useful keys: size, layout, isDisabled, className, and style. anylumino generates segments from items and manages value/onChange synchronization. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/SegmentedControl>. | `{}`       |
